findings.problem: The public max_rounds input is described and reported as a hard limit on model rounds, but the core checks roundState.round > maxRounds only after the provider response and all calls execute; the child then performs a tool-free wrap-up provider request.
findings.impact: With max_rounds=1, the offline child made three provider requests and two actual get_cwd invocations while the prompt and result promised one model turn and rounds≤1. Callers cannot rely on the configured round budget, and the terminal evidence contradicts measured execution.
findings.suggested_fix: Enforce the public child limit before issuing any provider request beyond it, including a wrap-up request, and add a child-path regression asserting total provider requests and actual tool invocations for max_rounds=1. Preserve legacy direct-agent N+1 semantics behind an explicit child adapter if global compatibility requires it.
